            )
            or having
        )
        # Aggregates that reference annotations containing window functions
        # cannot be inlined into the outer query as the resulting SQL would
        # nest a window function inside an aggregate, which is not allowed.
        # Such annotations must be computed in a subquery instead.
        refs_window = any(
            getattr(self.annotations[ref], "contains_over_clause", False)

        )
